lines: [room card PNG: cab R1, session, MOTION, Prep until 18:47, DRAW with sides and speakers, Adjudicator, QR of cab.uadebate.com/k7m2q9/1]

blocks.text: Before the ballot the draw shows Speakers only ("A & B"); once it is in, every speech with its points, the team's points and its place — an iron's second speech marked (iron). Before a motion: "Not set yet — the adjudicator sets it when the room begins." The prep line is the PrepClock hook counting down to the room's prep end. Same URL for every viewer — identity decides what the chrome offers. LiveView: re-renders the moment anything in the session changes (PubSub topic session:<uuid>) — no refresh, no polling. A member of a team in the room sees Give feedback (gold) once the ballot is in, until the session is finished; nobody else sees any feedback here.
